Description: Verify default fields auto-populate when creating a new ezdocs record

1. Open the EZdocs application and navigate to New Record
2. Select coverage type: Described Causes - Flood

Expected Results: Default fields such as Policy Effective Date, Coverage Type and Deductible defaults are populated according to the system rules defined in the logic file and match expected default values.

4. Save changes and review populated Deductible Amount field
Expected Results: When a valid Deductible Percent is selected the Deductible Amount is calculated and populated per mapping in Logic_1383.csv. Values match the expected calculated amounts.

Description: Verify system behavior when Deductible Percent and Deductible Amount conflict or invalid percent provided

Expected Results: The system displays appropriate validation messages and prevents saving when Deductible Percent is invalid or inconsistent with allowed mappings. No incorrect amounts are persisted.
